name: Muse AI Shot Renderer
description: Workflow con: nhận một video tham chiếu chuyển động và bộ ảnh nhân vật, tạo một shot bằng Muse AI rồi khớp thời lượng với nguồn.

nodes.title: Video tham chiếu chuyển động (tùy chọn)

params.template: Create one continuous vertical 9:16 video shot exactly {{duration_seconds}} seconds long. Preserve identity, face, hair and body proportions from the first character reference photo(s) only. When previous_shot_reference_count is 1, the next still image after the character reference(s) is a frame from the previous generated shot; use it only to match the exact outfit, hair and visual style, never identity, pose or product. Any product-only references follow that continuity frame; reproduce the product from the last product-only reference image exactly, ignoring people, pose, background or text in product references. Do not change the product's category, color, silhouette, material or details. Keep the exact same outfit across all shots and cut points, including garment cut, sleeve length, neckline, color, material and accessories. Use any attached reference video only for observed movement and framing; never copy its person, outfit, location or product, and do not use its duration instead of the requested duration. Observed movement: {{movement_analysis}}. Dance style: {{dance_type}}. Expression: {{expression}}. Wardrobe direction: {{outfit_desc}} {{wardrobe_styling}}. Setting: {{environment_desc}} {{scene_setting}}. Lighting: {{lighting_desc}} {{lens_light}}. Product: {{product_name}}. Category: {{product_category}}. Visible attributes: {{product_description}}. Required use mode: {{product_use_mode}}. Keep this product visible during the real use action: {{action}}; {{product_interaction}}. Product detail: {{product_focus}}. Framing: {{framing}}. Camera movement: {{camera_move}}. Emotional beat: {{emotion_beat}}. Motion direction: {{motion_direction}}. Additional shot direction: {{shot_prompt}}. Follow supplied shot directions. Keep natural body mechanics, stable anatomy and one continuous camera move. No cuts, product substitutions, unrelated clothing or accessories, captions, text, watermark or unsupported claims.
